subject: A lone hooded traveler in a long cloak seen from behind, standing on a rocky cliff edge and gazing up at a colossal glowing portal-rift torn across the twilight sky; through the shifting rifts many worlds are visible at once — a soaring fantasy castle on a mountain crag, a rain-slick neon cyberpunk city, and a vast starship drifting among ringed planets; sweeping epic vista, dramatic storm clouds, shafts of golden and blue light, foreground crags and mist
